```yaml
name: Release precompiled binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate tag against Cargo.toml
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          VERSION=$(grep '^version =' Cargo.toml | cut -d '"' -f2)
          if [ "$TAG" != "$VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Tag $TAG does not match Cargo.toml version $VERSION"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create draft release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          files: ''
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  build-linux-x86_64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        cuda: [none, 11.8, 12.4, 13.0]
    env:
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install lld
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld

      - name: Install CUDA
        if: matrix.cuda != 'none'
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.0
        with:
          cuda: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
          method: network

      - name: Build CLI
        uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          command: build
          args: --release
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Set artifact name
        id: setname
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cuda }}" = "none" ]; then
            echo "name=linux-x86_64-cpu" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "name=linux-x86_64-cuda-${{ matrix.cuda }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Package binary
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/release/cake dist/
          tar -czf dist/cake-${{ steps.setname.outputs.name }}.tar.gz -C dist cake
          shasum -a 256 dist/cake-${{ steps.setname.outputs.name }}.tar.gz > dist/cake-${{ steps.setname.outputs.name }}.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload binary
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/cake-${{ steps.setname.outputs.name }}.tar.gz
          asset_name: cake-${{ steps.setname.outputs.name }}.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

      - name: Upload checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/cake-${{ steps.setname.outputs.name }}.tar.gz.sha256
          asset_name: cake-${{ steps.setname.outputs.name }}.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

  build-linux-aarch64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install cross
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Build CLI aarch64
        uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          command: build
          args: --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          use-cross: true

      - name: Package binary
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/cake dist/
          tar -czf dist/cake-linux-aarch64.tar.gz -C dist cake
          shasum -a 256 dist/cake-linux-aarch64.tar.gz > dist/cake-linux-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload binary
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/cake-linux-aarch64.tar.gz
          asset_name: cake-linux-aarch64.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

      - name: Upload checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/cake-linux-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256
          asset_name: cake-linux-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

  build-macos-arm64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build CLI macOS arm64
        uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          command: build
          args: --release
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Package binary
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/release/cake dist/
          tar -czf dist/cake-macos-arm64.tar.gz -C dist cake
          shasum -a 256 dist/cake-macos-arm64.tar.gz > dist/cake-macos-arm64.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload binary
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/cake-macos-arm64.tar.gz
          asset_name: cake-macos-arm64.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

      - name: Upload checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/cake-macos-arm64.tar.gz.sha256
          asset_name: cake-macos-arm64.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

  build-android-aarch64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install cross
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Build mobile Android aarch64
        uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          command: build
          args: --release --target aarch64-linux-android
          use-cross: true

      - name: Package library
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/aarch64-linux-android/release/libcake_mobile.so dist/
          tar -czf dist/libcake_mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz -C dist libcake_mobile.so
          shasum -a 256 dist/libcake_mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz > dist/libcake_mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload library
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/libcake_mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz
          asset_name: libcake_mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

      - name: Upload checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/libcake_mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256
          asset_name: libcake_mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

  build-ios-arm64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build mobile iOS arm64
        uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          command: build
          args: --release --target aarch64-apple-ios
          toolchain: stable

      - name: Package static library
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libcake_mobile.a dist/
          tar -czf dist/libcake_mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz -C dist libcake_mobile.a
          shasum -a 256 dist/libcake_mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz > dist/libcake_mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload static library
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/libcake_mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz
          asset_name: libcake_mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          overwrite: true

      - name: Upload checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/libcake_mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz.sha256
          asset_name: libcake_mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.tag }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
```
